_comment: SZL Substrate MCP Gateway — Claude Desktop Configuration
_instructions: Add this configuration to your Claude Desktop mcpServers section.
Replace /path/to/szl-platform with the absolute path to this repository.
The gateway exposes Substrate workflows, approval gating, and counterfactual replay.
MCP Apps: Claude Desktop will automatically render interactive UIs for tools that
return ui:// resource references (data tables, charts, approval forms, metrics,
and timelines) as sandboxed in-chat applications.
SUBSTRATE_GATEWAY_API_KEY  — optional Bearer token for write operations
SUBSTRATE_SIGNING_KEY      — optional 32-byte hex HMAC key for evidence bundles
NODE_ENV                   — set to 'production' for strict auth enforcement

_alternative_http_transport._comment: Use HTTP+SSE transport instead of stdio for persistent connections

_tool_surface._comment: Tools exposed by this gateway with their MCP Apps UI references

substrate_list_workflows.renders: Interactive sortable/filterable table of workflows with CSV export

substrate_submit_run.description: Submit a workflow run through the policy + approval pipeline
substrate_submit_run.renders: KPI dashboard showing run status, confidence score, and stage progress

substrate_get_run.description: Get current state of a workflow run including stage evidence
substrate_get_run.renders: Chronological timeline of stage executions with severity and metadata

substrate_list_approvals.description: List pending approval gates requiring human authorization
substrate_list_approvals.renders: Governed approval form — operator can approve/reject inline in Claude Desktop

substrate_counterfactual.description: Run counterfactual replay with model or policy substitution
substrate_counterfactual.renders: Decision diff visualization showing per-stage confidence changes

_end_to_end_approval_flow._comment: Typical approval gate flow in Claude Desktop
steps: 1. Call substrate_submit_run with a workflow that has an ApprovalGate stage
2. The run pauses at the gate with status 'pending-approval'
3. Call substrate_list_approvals — Claude renders the ApprovalApp inline
4. Operator fills in rationale and clicks Approve/Reject in the in-chat UI
5. The ApprovalApp calls substrate_approve/substrate_reject via MCP tools/call bridge
6. The workflow resumes (or terminates if rejected) automatically
